education.degree: Diploma of Professional Studies in Technical Support
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration

highlights.description: Architected Impact Pilot, a pre-sales analytics motion built with Solution Engineers, driving $620K in ACV wins through Snowflake data modeling and Sigma-based categorical and time-series analysis.
Delivered a customer performance dashboard from stakeholder requirements to launch, giving 21 Customer Success Managers across 4 regions at-a-glance visibility into account health.
Owned end-to-end analyses quantifying Coveo's business impact, delivering 10+ reports to Value Engineers that surfaced $1M in ACV value and shaped customer-facing ROI conversations.
Drove $500K+ in ACV retention through exploratory customer data analysis, debugging Martech stacks and running Impact Realization analyses to close data gaps threatening renewals.

Established reliable, high-velocity analytics at the Value Engineering team, introducing Martech debugging and pre-sales motions to the function and earning the cross-functional trust that justified a new hire.
Planned and executed the migration to Google Analytics 4 across 6 subdomains, ensuring consistent measurement frameworks and unified user behavior tracking.

Engineered deterministic data stitching across GA4, Marketo, and Salesforce using the Marketo ID and lead ID, enabling full-funnel visibility into which leads and contacts visited key pages across subdomains.
Built and evolved 10+ production-grade marketing data models in dbt and Snowflake, forming the backbone of an end-to-end analytics workflow from modeling to visualization to insights.
Developed and evolved 7+ integrated dashboards using Tableau and Sigma, unifying data from Salesforce, BrightEdge, and Marketo to empower marketing decision-making with real-time KPI visibility.

Oversaw OneTrust across 6 subdomains to ensure compliance with global data protection laws, including consent management, tracking enforcement, and reporting on newly detected cookies in collaboration with the legal team.
Led web analytics measurement planning for clients, building the most suitable technology stack for tracking across web and product flows.
Implemented web tracking to measure business KPIs using Google Tag Manager, Segment, Mixpanel, and Google Analytics (Universal Analytics and GA4).
Led the migration to Google Analytics 4 for several client implementations, including e-commerce measurement.
Built dashboards and delivered monthly, cross-channel performance reports visualizing marketing and product KPIs and OKRs with actionable insights.
Analyzed existing tracking implementations to ensure data was captured correctly and to avoid tracking debt, while consulting with external teams on SEO and paid advertising effectiveness.
